#: Wound debuff descriptions in the Traits tab, one per stat code. Any ':' in a stat code is written as '-'. {0} is the change as a percentage (e.g. -15%), {1} the plain value (e.g. -2).
baby-explanation: Choose how your newborn looks. Pick a shape below, then a material for each part, such as skin, hair and eyes. The shapes after the server's are the designs in your pantograph portfolio, which keep their own materials. The previews show the result as you choose. Give them a name and press Confirm to receive them as a tabletop piece. If you close this menu, type .baby to open it again.
baby-name-checking: Checking whether the name is free...
baby-name-failed: Couldn't check the name right now. Trying again...
baby-portfolio-materials: This design from your portfolio keeps its own materials.
baby-piece-locked: A newborn can't be taken out of its tabletop piece.
baby-reshape-explanation: Pick a new shape below, then a material for each part, such as skin, hair and eyes. The shapes after the server's are the designs in your pantograph portfolio, which keep their own materials. Press Confirm to change the tabletop piece in your hand. Its name, size and anything stacked on it stay the same.
baby-command: Reopens the menu for a newborn that hasn't been named yet
